methodologyNotes: Roster covers ten verifiable models, all with confirmed USD pricing from US-market manufacturer pages or major US retailers (RehabMart, Target, official brand stores like powerplate.com / merachfit.com / eilisonglobal.com / pyleusa.com, and national supply retailers). Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages, authorized retailer listings, and official instruction manuals (ManualsLib). Sportstech VP300, Zaap TX-9000, and the VEVOR 350 lb model were excluded (per original draft) because no verified USD price could be confirmed from accessible US-market pages. Boolean field resistance_bands_included is true when bands are listed in-box by the manufacturer; motor_power_w reflects total combined wattage across all motors; max_frequency_hz is the upper end of the published frequency range. Adversarial pass corrections: LifePro Turbo 3D type corrected from '4d' to '3d' (it is a dual-motor 3D plate, not a triple-motor 4D unit, per LifePro/Target listing); MERACH CV55 name clarified to its official 'CV55 Curved 4D' product title; Bluefin speed_levels kept at 30 per the official ManualsLib instruction manual (brand marketing page lists 60 across preset+manual schemes). EILISON motor wattage remains null (unpublished by manufacturer); its 5-15 Hz range is review/marketing-sourced, not from a manufacturer spec sheet. release_year/releaseDate are null for all units as no manufacturer first-release date could be reliably confirmed. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: LifePro Waver Vibration Plate
products.provenance: Price $199.99 and specs (330 lb, 99 speeds, 4-12 Hz, 200W, oscillating, remote, resistance bands) re-confirmed directly from RehabMart listing and corroborated by the official LifePro Waver product page.

products.name: LifePro Rumblex 4D Vibration Plate
products.provenance: Price $399.99 (sale from $571.99) and specs (330 lb, 60 speeds, 4-40 Hz, 440W triple-motor 200+40+200, 4D oscillation+lateral+pulsation, watch remote, resistance/loop bands included) re-confirmed via RehabMart and the official LifePro product page.

products.name: LifePro Rumblex Plus 4D Vibration Plate
products.priceNote: Current sale price (reg. $574.99 per Haven of Heat)
products.provenance: Price $399.99 (Haven of Heat lists regular $574.99, not the $571.99 originally noted), 500 lb capacity, 60 speeds, 4-40 Hz, triple-motor 300+40+300 = 640W total, 4D vibration, wearable wrist remote, and 2 clip-on resistance bands + 4 mini loop bands confirmed via Haven of Heat authorized retailer and the official LifePro Rumblex Plus 4D page.

products.name: LifePro Turbo 3D Vibration Plate
products.provenance: Price $249.99 confirmed at Target. Specs (330 lb, 99 speeds, 4-15 Hz, 240W dual-motor 200W oscillation + 40W pulsation) verified from Target and the official LifePro page. CORRECTION: type changed from '4d' to '3d' - this is a dual-motor 3D plate (oscillation + pulsation), branded 'Turbo 3D' by LifePro, NOT a triple-motor 4D unit. Remote and resistance/loop bands included.

products.name: Power Plate MOVE
products.priceNote: Sale price from powerplate.com (reg. $3,720 for Red/Titanium/Black)
products.provenance: Price $2,976 (sale from $3,720) confirmed on powerplate.com official store. Specs: 300 lb capacity, 6 frequency settings spanning 30-40 Hz (30/35/40 Hz, each Low/High), ~285W nominal, no resistance bands (strap set + rubber mat included instead), remote control + Power Plate app. Uses PrecisionWave harmonic vibration; vertical/linear is the dominant axis. Corroborated by RehabMart listing.

products.name: Bluefin Fitness 4D Triple Motor Vibration Plate
products.provenance: US price $399 verified at National WP Supply. Max weight 330 lb and 30 speed levels confirmed via the official ManualsLib instruction manual (note: bluefinfitness.com marketing page lists 60 levels across 3 presets + 7 manual modes; the manual's 30 intensity levels is retained as the conservative manufacturer figure). Published frequencies: vertical 12 Hz, horizontal 11.3 Hz, micro-oscillation 34.6 Hz (used as max). 440W total motor power per bluefinfitness.com. Resistance cords + bands and wrist remote included per manual.

products.name: Hurtle HURVBTR30 Vibration Platform
products.provenance: Price $123.99 (reg. $177.13), 265 lb capacity, 20 speeds, 200W, detachable arm resistance bands, and remote control re-confirmed directly from Pyle USA (Hurtle's parent brand) official product page. Frequency range 5-13 Hz and oscillating type from the Whole Body Vibration Guide review.

products.name: EILISON FitMax 3D XL Vibration Plate
products.provenance: Price $179.99 (reg. $219.99) and 120 speed levels confirmed via Eilison Global official site. 300 lb max weight confirmed at Walmart (model KM-818). Max frequency ~15 Hz from a published 5-15 Hz range (marketing/review-sourced, not a manufacturer spec sheet). Motor wattage not published by manufacturer (kept null - a null beats a guess). Loop bands and a remote control included per listing. Brand calls this '3D XL'; motion is oscillating with an acupressure plate surface.

products.name: MERACH CV55 Curved 4D Vibration Plate
products.provenance: Price $249.99 (reg. $316.65) confirmed on MERACH official site. NAME CLARIFIED: official product-page title is 'CV55 Curved 4D Low-Impact Vibration Plate' (was 'SurgeVib CV55 4D'; SurgeVib survives only in the URL slug). 440 lb capacity, 120 speed levels, 5-45 Hz range, 440W triple motor, 4D motion (7 modes / 5 programs), elastic resistance bands, wristband remote and Merach app/Bluetooth confirmed via the official page and Amazon listing B0G55RKKYX.

products.name: MERACH CV61 Curved 4D Vibration Plate
products.provenance: Price $299.99 (reg. $499.98) and model CV61 ('CV61 Curved 4D Vibration Plate') confirmed on MERACH official site. 350 lb capacity, 120 speed levels (manual 1-120 + 3 auto programs), 5.5-37 Hz, 440W, 4D vibration (7 modes), elastic resistance bands, Bluetooth and app per merachfit.com spec table. Amplitude 0-11mm.
